verses.pali: “Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, abhāvitaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati abhāvitā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who haven’t developed mindfulness of the body haven’t developed freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, bhāvitaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati bhāvitā”ti.
verses.english: Those who have developed mindfulness of the body have developed freedom from death.”
